facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Buck was a big, happy dog. One night, someone stole Buck. Buck was taken to a cold place. Buck was taken from home.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Buck was a large, strong dog who lived in a warm house in California. He was happy and loved by his owner, Judge Miller. But one terrible night, a man stole Buck and sold him. Buck was sent far away to the frozen land of Alaska. Buck was taken from home. Everything Buck knew was suddenly taken away from him.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Buck was a magnificent dog who enjoyed a comfortable life at Judge Miller's grand estate in California. He spent his days playing in the sun-drenched gardens and sleeping by the warm fireplace. One fateful night, a treacherous gardener's helper kidnapped Buck and sold him to strangers. Before Buck could understand what was happening, he was shipped to the brutal cold of Alaska. Buck was taken from home. However, this cruel twist of fate would eventually awaken something powerful deep within Buck. Because he was torn from everything familiar and safe, Buck had no choice but to adapt or perish. The pampered house dog was about to discover a wild strength he never knew he possessed.
